body.kātyāyanaśulbasūtram: <1> rajjusamāsaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ 1 same śaṅkuṃ nikhāya śaṅkusammitayā rajjvā maṇḍalaṃ parilikhya yatra lekhayoḥ śaṅkvagracchāyā nipatati tatra śaṅkū nihanti sā prācī | tadantaraṃ rajjvābhyasya pāśau kṛtvā śaṅkvoḥ pāśau pratimucya dakṣiṇāyamya madhye śaṅkumevamuttarataḥ sodīcī 2 rajjvantayoḥ pāśau karoti | śroṇyaṃsanirañchanasaṃkhyāsamāsabhaṅgeṣu lakṣaṇāni | prācyantayoḥ śaṅku nihanti | śroṇyoraṃsayośca | śaṅkvoḥ pāśau pratimucya nirañchanena gṛhītvā dakṣiṇapūrvāṃ diśaṃ haranti | evamuttarataḥ | viparyasyetarataḥ | sa samādhiḥ sarvatra 3 pramāṇamabhyasyābhyāsacaturthe lakṣṇaṃ karoti tannirañchanam | akṣṇayā tiryaṅmānīśeṣa 4 pramāṇārdhaṃ vābhyasyābhyāsaṣaṣṭhe lakṣaṇaṃ karoti tannirañchanam | akṣṇayā tiryaṅmāniśeṣaḥ 5 pramāṇārdhe samacaturaśrasya śaṅkuḥ | śāstravadardhe dīrghacaturaśrasya | śakaṭamukhasya caivam 6 etena prāgvaṃśavedimānāni vyākhyātāni | śālāmānaṃ ca | tatrodīcī prācīvat | sadasaścaivam 7 aparimitaṃ pramāṇādbhūyaḥ 8 pramāṇe śāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ nirhāsavivṛddhyoḥ | yogaśca 9 itarasyavitṛtīye dakṣiṇata ityetadvakṣyāmaḥ | gārhapatyāhavanīyayorantarālaṃ ṣaḍhdhā saptadhā vāgantusamaṃ tredhā vibhajyāparavitṛtīyalakṣaṇena dakṣiṇāyamya tasminnagniḥ | viparyasyottarata utkaraḥ 10 apivāntaratribhāgo'nayā rajjvā purvārdhe samacaturaśraṃ kṛtvā śroṇyāmagniḥ | viparyasyottarāṃsa utkaraḥ 11 <2> aṅgulai rathasaṃmitāyāḥ pramāṇam | tatrāṣṭāśītiśatamīṣā | catuḥśatamakṣaḥ | ṣaḍaśītiryugam | catvāro'ṣṭakāḥ śamyā 1 paitṛkyāṃ dvipuruṣaṃ samacaturaśraṃ kṛtvā karaṇīmadhye śaṅkavaḥ sa samādhiḥ 2 karaṇī tatkaraṇī tiryaṅmānī pārśvamānyakṣṇayā ceti rajjavaḥ 3 padaṃ tiryaṅmānī tripadā pārśvamānī tasyākṣṇyā rajjurdaśakaraṇī 4 evaṃ dvipadā tiryaṅmānī ṣaṭpadā pārśvamānī tasyākṣṇayā rajjuścatvāriṃśatkaraṇī 5 upadiṣṭaṃ yugapramāṇaṃ śamyāpramāṇaṃ ca darśanāt 6 dīrghacaturaśrasyākṣṇayā rajjustiryaṅmānī pārśvamānī ca yatpṛthagbhūte kurutastadubhayaṃ karotīti kṣetrajñānam 7 samacaturaśrasyākṣṇayā rajjurdvikaraṇī 8 karaṇīṃ tṛtīyena vardhayettacca svacaturthenātmacatustṛṃśonena saviśeṣa iti viśeṣaḥ 9 pramāṇaṃ tiryak dvikaraṇyāyāmastasyākṣṇayā rajjustrikaraṇī 10 tṛtīyakaraṇyetena vyākhyātā | pramāṇavibhāgastu navadhā karaṇītṛtīyaṃ navabhāgaḥ | navabhāgāstrayastṛtīyakaraṇī 11 sautrāmaṇyāṃ prakramārthā | tṛtīyakaraṇī samāsārthā 12 tulyapramāṇānāṃ samacaturasrāṇāmuktaḥ samāsaḥ | nānāpramāṇasamāse hrasīyasaḥ karaṇyā varṣīyaso'pacchindyāttasyākṣṇayā rajjurubhe samasyatīti samāsaḥ 13 <3> caturaśrāccaturaśraṃ nirjihīrṣanyāvannirjihīrṣettāvadubhayato'pacchidya śaṅkū nikhāya pārśvamānīṃ kṛtvā pārśvamānīsammitāmakṣṇayāṃ tatropasaṃharati sa samāse'pacchedaḥ sā karaṇyeṣa nirhrāsaḥ 1 dīrghacaturaśraṃ samacaturaśraṃ cikīrṣan madhye tiryagapacchidyānyataradvibhajyetaratpurastāddakṣiṇataścopadadhyāccheṣamāgantunā purayettasyokto nirhrāsaḥ 2 atidīrghaṃ cettiryaṅmānyāpacchidyāpacchidyaikasamāsena samasya śeṣaṃ yathāyogamupasaṃharedityekaḥ samāsaḥ 3 samacaturaśraṃ dīrghacaturaśraṃ cikīrṣanmadhye'kṣṇayā'pacchidya tacca vibhajyānyataratpurastāduttarataścopadadhyādviṣamaṃ cedyathāyogamupasaṃharediti vyāsaḥ 4 pramāṇaṃ caturaśramādeśādanyat 5 dvipramāṇā catuḥkaraṇī tripramāṇa navakaraṇī catuḥpramāṇā ṣoḍaśakaraṇī 6 yāvatpramāṇā rajjurbhavati tāvantastāvanto vargā bhavanti tānsamasyet 7 ardhapramāṇena pādapramāṇaṃ vidhīyate | tṛtīyena navamaoṃ'śaḥ | caturthena ṣoḍaśī kalā 8 eṣa nirhrāsastasya purastāduktaṃ śāstram 9 yāvatpramāṇā rajjurbhavatīti vivṛddhe hrāso bhavati 10 caturaśraṃ maṇḍalaṃ cikīrṣanmadhyādaṃse nipātya pārśvataḥ parilikhya tatra yadatiriktaṃ bhavati tasya tṛtīyena saha maṇḍalaṃ parilikhet sa samādhiḥ 11 maṇḍalaṃ caturaśraṃ cikīrṣan viṣkambhaṃ pañcadaśabhāgān kṛtvā dvāvuddhareccheṣaḥ karaṇī 12 <4> droṇacidrathacakracitkaṅkacitpraugacidubhayataḥ praugaḥ samuhyapurīṣa ityagnayaḥ 1 droṇe yāvānagniḥ sapakṣapucchaviśeṣastāvaccaturaśraṃ kṛtvā droṇadaśamavibhāgo vṛntamityeke | taddaśamenāpacchidyāpacchidyaikasamāsena samasya nirhṛtya sarvamagniṃ tathākṛtiṃ kṛtvā purastātpaścādvopadadhyāt | maṇḍale'pyevam 2 prauge yāvānagniḥ sapakṣapucchaviśeṣastāvaddviguṇaṃ caturaśraṃ kṛtvā yaḥ purastātkaraṇīmadhye śaṅkuryau ca śroṇyoḥ so'gniḥ 3 ubhayataḥ prauge tāvadeva dīrghacaturaśraṃ kṛtvā karaṇīmadhyeṣu śaṅkavaḥ sa samādhiḥ 4 praugaṃ caturaśraṃ cikīrṣanmadhye prāñcamapacchidya viparyasyetarata upadhāya dīrghacaturaśrasamāsena samasyet sa samādhiḥ 5 ubhayataḥ praugaṃ cenmadhye tiryagapacchidya pūrvavatsamasyet 6 etenaiva trikarṇasamāso vyākhyātaḥ | pañcakarṇānāṃ ca | prauge'pacchidyaikakarṇānāṃ | dvikarṇānāṃ samacaturaśre'pacchidya 7 <5> uttareṣu puruṣoccayenaikaśatavidhādityetadvakṣyāmaḥ 1 ādyo'gnirdviguṇastriguṇo bhavatīti sarvasamāsaḥ 2 ekaviṃśatividho bhavatīti puruṣābhyāsaḥ 3 puruṣābhyāse yāvānagniḥ sapakṣapucchaviśeṣastāvaccaturaśraṃ kṛtvā tasminpuruṣapramāṇamavadadhyāt 4 samastaṃ pañcadaśabhāgānkṛtvā dvāvekasamāsena samasyet sa puruṣaḥ 5 pañcavibhāgena bṛhatī tasya daśamavibhāgena pādamātrī bhavati 6 puruṣaṃ vā pañcamenobhayato'pacchidya pañcavibhāgansamasya tṛtīyaṃ nirhṛtya tasminpuruṣapramāṇe'vadadhyādityaparam 7 pañcadaśavibhāgo'ṣṭāṅgulam 8 pañcāratnirdaśavitastirviṃśatiśatāṅgulaḥ puruṣa ityetasmāddvādaśāṅgulaṃ padamiti ca 9 puruṣaṃ vā saptamenobhayato'pacchidya saptabhāgānsamasya sasaptamabhāgamaṅgulaṃ nirhṛtya puruṣapramāṇe'vadadhyādityaparam 10 nāratnivitastīnāṃ samāso vidyate saṃkhyāyogāditi śruteḥ 11 <6> yathāgni vedīṣṭakāpramāṇaṃ varddhata ityetadvakṣyāmaḥ 1 yākaraṇī caturdaśaprakramānsaṅkṣipati triṃśca prakramasaptamabhāgān sa ekaśatavidhe prakramaḥ 2 dvitīye vā saptasu prakrameṣu prakramamavadhāya tasya saptamabhāgena prakramārthaḥ 3 prakrameṇa vā saptamabhāgena prakramārthaḥ 4 evamaikaśatavidhāt 5 nāntaḥpātyagārhapatyayorvṛddhirbhavati tāvadeva yonirbhavati na vai jātaṃ garbhaṃ yoniranuvardhata iti śrutervṛddheratyantaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ 6 yāvatpramāṇāni samacaturaśrāṇyekīkartuṃ cikīrṣedekonāni tāni bhavanti tiryagdviguṇānyekata ekādhikāni tryasrirbhavati tasyeṣustatkaroti 7 yathāyūpaṃ vedivarddhanamityetadvakṣyāmaḥ 8 yā rajjurekādaśoparavānsaṅkṣipati daśa ca rathākṣāṃstasyā yaścaturviṃśo bhāgaḥ sa prakramaḥ 9 tena vediṃ nirmāya dvādaśāṅgulaṃ purastādapacchidya tadyūpāvatyācchaṅkoḥ purastātprāñcamavadhāya tasmin yūpānminoti 10 pārśvayorvā'rdhamantarvedīti śruterarddhakāniti 11 eke prathamottamau prakṛtivat 12 saiṣā śikhaṇḍinī vediḥ 13 <7> bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ dvihaste lakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt trihasto madhyamaḥ śiraḥ 1 śiraḥpaścādvitastiḥ syāt pūrvārdhe hasta eva ca sārdhahaste ca pāśaḥ syāt vediḥ syāt paurṇamāsikī 2 saṃkhyājñaḥ parimāṇajñaḥ samasūtranirañchakaḥ samabhūmau bhavedvidvāñchulbavit paripṛcchakaḥ 3 na jalāt samamanyat syānnānyadvātāt pramā bhavet nānyaddūraṃ bhramādūrdhvaṃ nānyat sūtrādṛjurbhavet 4 tiryaṅmānyāśca sarvārthaiḥ pārśvamānyāśca yogavit karaṇīnāṃ vibhāgajño nityodyuktaśca karmasu 5 śāstrabudhyā vibhāgajñaḥ paraśāstrakutūhalaḥ śilpibhyaḥ sthapatibhyaśca ādadīta matīḥ sadā 6 ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamucchritam jaraṭhaṃ cāvraṇaṃ caiva śaṅkuṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ 7 dvivitastipramāṇastu khādiro mudgarastathā śaṅkustena nikhātavyastasmāttasya parigrahaḥ 8 ekatastu ṛjustīkṣṇaḥ khādiraḥ samamāyataḥ śaṅkuḥ kāryastu śulbajñaistasyārdhaṃ gamayenmahīm 9 prādeśamātro haviryajñe pūrvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ śaṅkurāmaśirāḥ kāryastasyāpyardhaṃ nikhāpayet 10 caturasramudgaraṃ syāt ṣoḍaśāṅgulamāyatam aviddhaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca dārumadhyācca nirmitam 11 ajīrṇā'granthinī sūkṣmā samā ślakṣṇā tvaromaśā rajjurmānādhikā kāryā adhvare yogamicchatā 12 śāṇī vā bālvajī caiva vaiṇavī vā vidhīyate rajjustūbhayataḥpāśā trivṛtā yajñakarmaṇi 13 rajjurmuñjamayī kāryā śaṇaistu parimiśritā kātyāyano vadatyevamakhaṇḍā kuśabalbajaiḥ 14 navake lakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt trīṇi kuryāt triṣu triṣu uttamo navakaḥ pāśaḥ sadaso mānamucyate 15 pañcadaśamathaikaviṃśatikamaparaṃ parastrikaṃ ca dvādaśasu pāśa uttama iti some rajjumānametat 16 padasyākṣṇayā tiraścī tayorakṣṇayā bhavet sautrāmaṇyāṃ vimātavyā vediḥ syāt somavattayā 17 nīhāreṇa ghanairvāpi jyotiṣāmabhradarśane apsu dīpaṃ pragṛhṇīyādyāvattamasi darśane 18 pramāṇaṃ ca prameyaṃ ca yaccānyadvastusaṃjñakam sarvaṃ tacchāstrato jñātvā yajñe sidhyanti yājñikāḥ 19 yathā na kṣīyate mānaṃ yathā ca na vivardhate yathā ca ramate dṛṣṭistathā yogaṃ samācaret 20 aratniścaturasrastu pūvasyāgneḥ kharo bhavet rathacakrākṛtiḥ paścāccandrārdha iva dakṣiṇaḥ 21 agnīnāṃ tu kharaḥ kāryo mekhalātrayasaṃyutaḥ dvādaśāṅgula ucchrāye vistāre caturaṅgulaḥ 22 tantuḥ puṣkaranālasya ṣaḍguṇaḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ vatsataryāstrihāyaṇyā bālena sadṛśo bhavet 23 trayastrihāyaṇībālāḥ sarṣapārdhaṃ pracakṣate dviguṇaṃ sarṣapaṃ vidyādyavaḥ pañca tu sarṣapāḥ 24 aṅgulasya pramāṇaṃ tu ṣaḍyavāḥ pārśvasaṃsthitāḥ caturviṃśāṅgulo'ratnirvitastirdvādaśāṅgulā 25 vyāmasyātra pramāṇaṃ tu caturnyūnaṃ śataṃ bhavet puruṣasya pramāṇaṃ vai viṃśatistu śatādhikā 26 hiraṇyaśakalārthe tu hiraṇyaṃ yasya nocyate kṛṣṇalenaiva tadvyākhyā yajñe sidhyati yājñikī 27 kṛṣṇalaṃ triyavaṃ mānaṃ tāmrāyasamataḥ param suvarṇādardhaṃ ca māṣāṇāṃ suvarṇāśca trisaptatiḥ 28 trīṇi caiva sahasrāṇi dadyādbahusuvarṇake bhūyaḥ sthapatito jñātvā saṃjñāsvanyāsu mānavit svarṇakāro yathā'bhyāsāttathā bhūyo vivardhate 29 hrasate śoṣapākābhyāṃ dvātriṃśadbhāgamiṣṭakā tasmādārdrapramāṇaṃ tu kuryānmānādhikaṃ budhaḥ 30 ajñātvā śulbasadbhāvaṃ yajñe sautrāmaṇīsute vediṃ ye kartumicchanti giriṃ bhindanti te nakhaiḥ 31 daṇḍarajjvardhamabhyasya ṣaṣṭhe tvardhasya lakṣaṇam tathaiva cetaratrāpi tiryaṅmānaṃ yadṛcchayā 32 yāvatpramāṇā rajjuḥ syāttāvānevāgamo bhavet āgamārdhe bhavecchaṅkustadardhe ca nirañchanam 33 ādhāne padikaṃ kuryāt dvipadaḥ saumiko bhavet agnau ca tripadaṃ kuryāt prakramaṃ yājñiko budhaḥ 34 kṛttikā śravaṇaḥ puṣyaścitrāsvātyoryadantaram etatprācyā diśo rūpaṃ yugamātrodite puraḥ 35 pañcāśaccharkarāḥ paścāt pūrve deyāstrisaptatiḥ dakṣiṇe tu pradātavyā daśa pañca ca sapta ca 36 śaṃsyaścaturviṃśatipārśvabhāgaścaturdaśabhiḥ parilekhyastu naryam tathaiva cāṣṭadviguṇairatharyyastriṃśadbhirāyamya harettṛtīyam 37 agnerudaksārdhanavāṅgule madhyaṃ tato likhet vṛttamekonaviṃśatyā prācījyā madhyagā bhavet udagardhaṃ vihāyārvāk kharāgnerdakṣiṇasya tu 38 sūtradoṣadaridrasya gūḍhamantrasya dhīmataḥ samāpteyaṃ kriyā śaulbī kātyāyanamahātmanaḥ 39 iti kātyāyanaśulbasūtram
